cases.title: [AI] Fix category_group rule conditions never matching live transactions
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: "category group" rule condition only works via the rule editor's own Apply actions - fails via "Run rules" and auto-run-on-save
cases.why: The report says a rule with a 'category group' condition does not run when a new transaction in a category of that group is saved, so on the buggy build the rule's notes action never shows in the register; on the fixed build it does.

result.why: The application is not showing the saved note text for the Grocer transaction.

cases.title: [AI] Fix stale session token recovery
cases.issueTitle: 🤖 [Bug]: Stale OIDC session token leaves cached budget stuck on repeated 401s
cases.why: The bug only appears with a sync server, OpenID login and a stale or expired server session token, and this environment has no server, no login and no sync.

cases.title: [AI] fix(api): translate default rule stage at API boundary
cases.issueTitle: Docs: rules API says stage must be pre/default/post, but "default" is rejected and null is undocumented
cases.why: The report covers the API reference docs and the rules API validator, which a user reaches only by calling @actual-app/api against a server, so no action in the local web app shows a difference between the fixed and buggy builds.

cases.title: [AI] Fix scheduled split transfer previews
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Scheduled split transfers do not show as upcoming transactions on destination accounts
cases.why: Reproducing this needs a second account, a new schedule turned into a split, and one split line set as a transfer, which takes well over 6 short steps; it also depends on a schedule date showing as upcoming, which ties it to the run date.

cases.title: [AI] Respect the date format preference in daily and weekly report intervals
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Custom reports based on weekly or daily interval display do not respect date style preference
cases.why: The report never says exactly what the fixed date labels look like (full year or not, which separators), and the labels depend on transaction dates and the report's date range, which change from run to run, so no exact expected text can be stated with certainty.

cases.title: [AI] Fix stuck update button and useless fatal error details
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: FatalError: renderWithHooks (/js/client.pqETbwxE.chunk.js:8:92835)
cases.why: The report is about an app update prompt on a hosted server (Pikapods), followed by a fatal error after a browser refresh. It gives no steps to reproduce and does not say what correct output looks like, and the bug depends on a server and on update timing.

cases.title: [AI] Fix duplicate payees in rules after merging payees (#6486)
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Duplicate entry in rule one of list after payee name merge
cases.why: The report gives no exact text for how the fixed rule should look after the merge, and the only visible difference is how many times one payee name appears in the "one of" list, which is a count rather than one fixed piece of text; setting it up also takes payee creation, rule creation and a rule-merging payee merge, which does not fit reliably in 2 to 6 steps.

cases.title: [AI] Default new transaction amount filters to positive values
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Filter on "Amount" field is not working as expected
cases.why: The report gives a clear expected result (an Amount 'greater than 150' filter lists only transactions above 150), and two deposits on either side of 150 show it on screen without needing a server, sync or special setup.

result.why: The list includes a transaction with payee Alpha in the result shown to the user.

cases.title: Fix amount resetting to zero (#6056)
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Entering an amount and then pressing Cleared toggle clears the amount
cases.why: The bug is only in the mobile Add Transaction page with its Cleared toggle and on-screen keyboard, which needs a mobile layout; the rules exclude that, so this desktop Chrome 1920x1080 run can't reproduce it.

cases.title: Skip overspent sources when a named cleanup pool collects funds
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Named pool sources process negative balances instead of being ignored
cases.why: The report does not say how to set up the named pool or which cleanup notes and settings to use (it only says "configured via the UI"), and the cleanup feature may need an experimental setting, so the setup steps can't be written with certainty from the report alone.

cases.title: [AI] Fix phantom overspending after deleting a category
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Deleting Certain Categories Creates Irreconcilable Phantom Overspend
cases.why: The report gives a full from-scratch repro using one account, two categories, a deposit, a budget transfer and a category delete. In the next month the fixed app should show no overspend, while the buggy app shows a phantom 10.00 overspent.

result.why: Could not tell whether the failure was at a check or an action.

cases.title: [AI] Fix category and group menus not opening after a rename
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Dropdown menu for groups/categories disabled after rename unless you refresh browser tab
cases.why: The report gives clear local steps: rename a category on the Budget page, then open its dropdown menu again. On the buggy build the menu does not appear, and on the fixed build it opens with its Rename option.

result.why: The replay checked for an open menu without first getting the page into that state.

cases.title: [AI] Fix bulk edit date picker formatting regression
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Bulk edit date picker modal visual regression
cases.why: The report describes only a visual layout regression of the bulk-edit date picker modal (shown in screenshots), with no text, value, or behavior change that a Verify step could read, and it says the functionality is unchanged.

cases.title: [AI] Surface the real GoCardless error reason in the UI
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Gocardless error messages are not shown in actual budget UI
cases.why: The bug only shows during GoCardless bank sync, which needs a sync server, a GoCardless account and a network connection to a bank provider, and none of these exist in a local app with no server.

cases.title: [AI] Fix schedule service shutdown race
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: API: schedule service crashes when shutdown wins the race with its queued run
cases.why: The bug is a rare timing race in the Node API (@actual-app/api) between shutdown() and a queued schedule service, and it needs a sync server, a specific budget metadata.json, and many repeated runs, none of which a single browser test can reproduce.

cases.title: fix schedules not showing as paid
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Schedules not staying at top of list as [PAID] on the day they are scheduled for
cases.why: The bug only shows for a schedule that falls due on today's date and runs automatically, so the test would depend on the current date and on when the schedule runs, and the report never says exactly what text or position the fixed Schedules page shows.

cases.title: [AI] Keep net worth stable across transfer dates
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Net worth widget incorrectly shows change when transferring between accounts
cases.why: The bug shows up only as a shape in the net worth graph across months relative to today's date, and the report doesn't give an exact visible text value that the fixed app shows and the buggy app doesn't, so there's no single reliable fact to verify.

cases.title: Schedule forecast smoothing
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Schedule template budget calculation incorrect for multiple non-monthly scheduled transactions
cases.why: Both reports depend on schedule due dates relative to the current month and on budgeting earlier months (and #6644 gives no correct amount), so the expected budget changes with the date the test runs and cannot be pinned to one fixed value.

cases.title: [AI] Add Tags to bulk edit notes
cases.issueTitle: [Feature] Show Tags when Bulk-editing Notes
cases.why: This is a feature request with no described solution, so the report never says what the bulk-edit Notes field should show (for example, which suggestion list or text) and no exact visible fact can be derived with certainty.

cases.title: [AI] Keep focus on parent payment when enabling split
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Creating a split transaction directly jumps to the first split line.
cases.why: The bug is only about where keyboard focus lands after choosing Split with the keyboard, and the report names no visible text that differs; Kane replays typing into the field it recorded, so the test would pass on the buggy build too.

cases.title: [AI] Only show stacked bar tooltip truncation indicator when categories are hidden
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Custom report widget of barchart mouseover legend is truncated incorrectly
cases.why: Reproducing it needs spending in more than four categories across several months, plus a saved custom report added as a dashboard widget. You then have to hover over chart bars to see a tooltip, and the report never says what the tooltip should show, so there is no exact text to check.

cases.title: :hedgehog:  Speeding up large budgets by only running rules when needed
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Balance calculation for rule application making schedule preview transactions slow
cases.why: The report is about performance: preview transactions load slowly in very large accounts because rules recalculate the balance. The fixed and buggy builds show the same values on screen, so the only difference is timing, and that needs a large data set.

cases.title: [AI] Expose tag splitting and scope selection in custom reports
cases.issueTitle: [Feature] Ability to create report widgets splitting category with tags in notes
cases.why: This is a feature request with no described correct output, so I can't derive a concrete UI or expected value with certainty from the report: it doesn't say what the widget is called, how tags are picked up, or how the pie labels and amounts appear.

cases.title: [AI] fix(schedules): allow auto-posting to run again the same day
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Automatic scheduled transaction posting a day late— Desktop 26.9.0
cases.why: The bug depends on today's date, the time zone and the schedule's due-date timing (it posts a day late, on the Windows desktop app), so no fixed visible fact can be checked the same way on every run without dates or a time zone.

cases.title: [AI] Show commit hash on edge/nightly builds
cases.issueTitle: [Tech Debt] Incorrect `edge` version shown in app
cases.why: The correct output is a build-specific commit hash or other unique identifier that the report does not give, and it depends on how the edge build was deployed, so no exact expected text can be named.

cases.title: fix: match "is nothing" rule conditions on transactions without a payee or category
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Rule with payee is "nothing" never matching
cases.why: The report is about rules not running on transactions imported by bank sync (Pluggy), and the rule's conditions and actions are only in a screenshot I can't see, so the correct result can't be worked out with certainty or reproduced without a sync server.

cases.title: fix: point the tour's "To Budget" step at a displayed month
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: tour points to non-existent "To Budget" when non-current month is selected
cases.why: The report says the tour's "To Budget" step points at the wrong place when another month is shown, but it never says what the fixed tour should show (jump back to the current month, skip the step, or point at a different element), so there is no exact visible text to check for.

cases.title: fix: keep loading off-screen dashboard widgets after toggling edit mode
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Off screen reports don't load if editing page quickly
cases.why: The bug depends on timing (clicking Edit Dashboard while widgets are still loading), needs a dashboard with many widgets that are off screen, and the report gives no exact visible text to check, so the outcome cannot be checked reliably.

cases.title: [AI] Fix live spending reports not updating on month rollover
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: "Live" spending reports don't update automatically after #7672
cases.why: The bug only appears when the calendar month rolls over after a live spending report is created, which depends on time passing and cannot be reproduced within one fixed test run.

cases.title: [AI] Fix running balance text selection in draggable transaction rows
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Running balance text selection partially broken
cases.why: The bug only shows in Firefox (the reporter says Chromium works fine) and it needs a mouse drag to select text, so a Chrome replay can't tell the fixed and buggy builds apart.

cases.title: [AI] Don't learn a category rule that a "one of" rule already covers
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Automatic rules don't check if a rule exists with that payee in the "one of" list
cases.why: The report only says an extra rule should not appear, and it does not say when Actual creates automatic rules (for example, after how many transactions), so the one difference between the builds is something missing rather than a fixed visible fact a single Verify step could read.

cases.title: [AI] Preserve skipped schedule dates when editing schedules
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Editing a schedule brings back an occurrence that was skipped
cases.why: The report says that after you skip the next occurrence of a monthly schedule with an account and then rename it, the buggy build puts the status back to Due, while the fixed build keeps it Scheduled.

result.why: The schedules list is showing the wrong status for the Broadband schedule.

cases.title: [AI] preserve category when making transfer between on/off-budget accounts
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Category is cleared when transactions are changed to a transfer
cases.why: The report gives clear local steps: on fixed builds the on-budget transaction keeps its category when it becomes a transfer to an off-budget account, and on buggy builds the Category cell is empty.

result.why: the recording does not replay on the fixed build

cases.title: [AI] Show the running balance when sorted by date oldest first
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Running balance not visible when sortin by oldest transaction first
cases.why: The report gives clear steps and an exact expected result: the running balance column should still show after sorting by Date oldest-first. With a single deposit, the balance value is certain.

result.why: the buggy build passes too: the test does not reach the bug

cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Search not working as expected.

cases.title: [AI] Match nothing for an invalid regex instead of failing the rule preview
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Rules notes with matches has a bug

result.why: the fixed build fails the test: The required trailing backslash was not present in the value field when the check ran.

cases.title: fix: api allow partial category updates without name (#8857)
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: api.updateCategory throws TypeError on any partial update that omits name
cases.why: The bug is only in the @actual-app/api updateCategory call made from code (the report says no browser is involved), so moving or hiding a category in the web UI may not go through the broken code and a UI test cannot show the TypeError.

cases.title: [AI] fix: Preserve disappearing split payees (in account) after posting transactions
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Converted schedule is incorrect for split transactions with multiple payees
cases.why: Reproducing this needs a transaction with a future date, which the rules forbid, and the flow (build a split with two payees, convert it to a schedule, post it from the Schedules list, then check the child payees) cannot fit in 2 to 6 steps.

cases.title: [AI] Explain SimpleFIN outages instead of a generic internal error
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: unclean handling of SimpleFIN downtime
cases.why: The bug only shows when the app syncs a linked SimpleFIN bank account and SimpleFIN's server returns a maintenance page, which needs a sync server, a bank connection and outside network access, none of which this setup has.

cases.title: [AI] Keep split child fields when updating a transaction through the API
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Calling API updateTransaction for a sub-transaction clears the category & amount
cases.why: The bug only shows up when the @actual-app/api Node package calls updateTransaction on a sub-transaction, and the report never says that editing a split's notes in the browser UI causes it, so a UI-only test can't reliably reproduce it.

cases.title: Fix template over-budget when a rule's schedule has a split with no category
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Schedule template over-budgets a category when the schedule's rule has a split with no category

cases.title: fix: exclude income from spending analysis budget
cases.issueTitle: [Bug]: Spending Analysis in Tracking Budget uses wrong amount.

cases.title: [AI] Keep the search applied after toggling reconciled transactions
